title: LegalDocumentFulltext
description: Full text of a legal document (body, and subject where extractable), published separately from LegalDocument per DATA_POLICY.md's source-vs-derived separation and ADR-0005's license posture. One record per canonical_id; canonical_id is a foreign key into legal-corpus.json, not an independent identity.

canonical_id.description: Must match a canonical_id in the corresponding legal-corpus.json release.

body.description: Full text of the document, extracted verbatim from its official page. One flat field; article/clause segmentation is not attempted (see CONTEXT.md).

subject.description: What the document is actually about, extracted verbatim from a specific structural span of the source page. Omitted (not null) when no such span was found — consumers fall back to the metadata record's subject_slug.

version.description: VNKC record version; increments on every change, never overwrites.
